mentions.name: Vicena.ai
mentions.description: Vicena.ai is an AI for Science platform for designing, simulating and testing new battery chemistries, new drugs, and other scientific work with the same ease as building software with coding agents. It connects AI to scientific compute and a network of labs, so science can be done end-to-end from a computer.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Vicena.ai allows you to design, simulate and test new battery chemistries, new drugs… With the same ease as building software with coding agents.

It is an AI for Science connected to scientific compute and a network of labs, so you can do science end-to-end from your computer.

mentions.name: Vicena
mentions.description: This is an AI for science and engineering connected to scientific papers, scientific simulators, and specialized models. It can order real physical experiments executed as tool calls through partner CloudLabs and planned robotic labs, running systematic hypothesis-experiment loops that follow the scientific method.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We are creating an AI for science and engineering: https://vicena.ai

It's connected to all papers of course, and all kinds of scientific simulators and specialised models.
